test_subdirectory_hint_tracker: test the SubdirectoryHintTracker class discovers AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and .cursorrules files in subdirectories
test_ancestor_walk_discovery: test that reading a deeply nested file like backend/src/main.py discovers ancestor AGENTS.md via ancestor walk
test_terminal_command_path_extraction: test that paths extracted from terminal commands trigger subdirectory hint discovery
test_no_duplicate_loading: test that the same directory is not loaded twice by SubdirectoryHintTracker
test_permission_error_handling: test that PermissionError exceptions are gracefully handled without crashing
